scope: safe, local-only inspection + model-free regression tests; no external scanning, no exploitation

controls.evidence: _authorised returns False for missing/wrong/empty token when ACCESS_TOKEN set; tests AuthorisedTests
POST /auth/ticket takes Bearer header (not URL); returns single-use ?ticket=; legacy ?token= documented as visible in URL/logs
_consume_ticket pops on first use; expiry enforced; stale purged on issue; 192-bit secrets.token_urlsafe(24); TicketTests + test_ws_server
_origin_ok parses hostname; localhost/allowlist only; localhost.evil.com rejected; no-Origin allowed for non-browser; OriginTests
test_xss (6 tests): browser client uses textContent not innerHTML; server fallback page safe; no other sinks
64KB voice frame, 64KB telephony text, 32KB payload chars; oversized closes 1009 (test_ws_server); FrameCapTests guards values
MAX_SESSIONS_PER_IP=8; excess closes 4429; slots released on disconnect (test_ws_server)
_bind_security_error: non-localhost without token -> startup exit 1; BindSecurityTests + test_ws_server.test_main_refuses_insecure_bind
check_lan_tls L1-L9 9/9 PASS (lan_tls_check_v2.json); self-signed cert SANs localhost/LAN; physical phone NOT TESTED
uvicorn log_level=warning suppresses access logs (?token= URLs); startup banner prints <your-token> placeholder only; LogRedactionTests asserts token value never printed
token-gated fail-closed; counts/timings only, no transcripts/audio/IPs; test_metrics (3 tests)
decode exception emits error event (stage=asr, message truncated 200 chars), socket usable next turn (test_ws_server D1)

pip-audit not installed and no network audit authorized; requirements mostly pinned (sherpa-onnx==2.0.1, numpy==2.5.5, scipy==1.18.1, fastapi==0.163.1, uvicorn==0.54.0, websockets==17.4); onnxruntime>=1.20, cryptography>=42, aiohttp>=3.9 are floors. Run 'pip install pip-audit && pip-audit -r requirements.txt' to activate.

considerations_not_vulnerabilities: /health is unauthenticated by design (monitoring); exposes backend/model names and readiness, not secrets. Acceptable on localhost; for public deployment consider gating or minimizing.
ASR error events send str(exc)[:200] to the connected caller; cloud SDK errors do not include API keys, but truncation limits any accidental detail.
Tickets are single-process in-memory; a multi-worker deployment needs a shared store (documented in DEPLOYMENT_V1).
acceptance_gate_security: PASS (automated, local) for auth/origin/limits/TLS/log-redaction/XSS; dependency CVE scan NOT TESTED. No control was weakened.
